Product Overview

The Anapaya EDGE provides a practical and manageable way to connect existing services and networks to the SCION Internet. The EDGE is a software-based network appliance solution that functions as a secure entry point, or gateway, for an organization’s network to access the SCION Internet. Available as a virtual network appliance, the EDGE provides significant deployment flexibility to integrate into existing enterprise IT infrastructures.

For more information, visit the Anapaya Learning Center
